text: Neural-Network View of Memetic Search Let a neural network controller or predictor be parameterized by weights w e R A memetic algorithm can optimize w through two interacting mechanisms: @ evolutionary step: w=w-+e which explores qualitatively different parameter regions @ local refinement: w' =w—nVF(w) which sharpens a promising parameter vector So the memetic neural-network update is conceptually: w' =w +e—nVF(w). This gives both parameter diversity and targeted refinement.
